privacyPolicy.intro: This page describes how Rezervo Mjekun collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: Rezervo Mjekun ("we", "us", "our") is a booking platform that connects patients with clinics and doctors in Kosovo. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, and how it is used, shared, and protected when you use our website and services.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, and appointment details when you register, book, or manage an appointment. Clinics and doctors provide professional information such as specialty, license number, and working schedules. We also collect technical information such as device, browser, and log data to keep the service secure and reliable.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to create and manage your account, process and confirm appointment bookings, send appointment-related notifications, communicate with you about your account, and improve the safety, reliability, and performance of the platform. We do not use your health-related booking information for advertising.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of Information
sections.body: We share appointment details with the clinic and doctor you book with, since that is necessary to provide the service. We may share information with service providers who help us operate the platform (such as hosting and infrastructure providers), and where required by law or to protect the rights, safety, and property of Rezervo Mjekun, our users, or the public. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
sections.body: We apply technical and organizational measures designed to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we work to continually improve these safeguards, particularly given the sensitivity of health-related booking data.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service, comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. You can review and update most account information directly from your profile, or contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: 8. Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies and similar local storage to keep you signed in, remember your language and theme preferences, and keep the platform functioning correctly. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.body: A parent or guardian may book appointments on behalf of a minor dependent through their own account. The platform is not intended for direct use by children without a parent or guardian.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will take reasonable steps to notify you, such as posting a notice on the platform.

sections.heading: 11. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us at info@rezervomjekun.com.

termsOfService.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Rezervo Mjekun booking platform.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using the Rezervo Mjekun platform, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.body: Rezervo Mjekun is an online booking platform that lets patients find doctors and clinics in Kosovo and reserve appointments. It is a scheduling intermediary — it does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a party to the medical relationship between a patient and a clinic or doctor.

sections.heading: 3. User Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You agree to provide accurate and current information when registering and when booking appointments.

sections.heading: 4. Booking and Cancellation
sections.body: When you book an appointment, the clinic or doctor is notified and the slot is reserved on your behalf. Cancellation and rescheduling are subject to the availability shown on the platform and to each clinic's own policies. Repeated no-shows or late cancellations may affect your ability to book through the platform.

sections.heading: 5. Clinic and Doctor Responsibilities
sections.body: Clinics and doctors using Rezervo Mjekun are responsible for the accuracy of their listed information, the availability they publish, and the medical care they provide. Rezervo Mjekun reviews and approves clinic registrations but does not independently verify every credential and is not responsible for the quality of care delivered.

sections.heading: 6. Medical Disclaimer
sections.body: Rezervo Mjekun does not provide medical advice. Information shown on the platform (such as specialties or service descriptions) is provided by clinics and doctors and is for scheduling purposes only. Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare provider for any medical concerns, and call emergency services in the case of a medical emergency.

sections.heading: 7. User Conduct
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the platform, including by providing false information, attempting to access accounts that are not yours, or interfering with the platform's normal operation.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, Rezervo Mjekun is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform, or from the acts or omissions of clinics and doctors who use it to manage their schedules.

sections.heading: 9. Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate access to the platform for accounts that violate these Terms or that we reasonably believe pose a risk to other users or to the platform.

sections.heading: 10. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Kosovo, without regard to its conflict-of-law principles.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes, we will take reasonable steps to notify you, such as posting a notice on the platform.

sections.heading: 12. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, contact us at info@rezervomjekun.com.
